done_when: Every review gets the '## Review rules' section of the repo's AGENTS.md, read from the default branch and placed outside the Forge-managed block, as rules the reviewer follows, the same way '## Known traps' reaches cold reads (reuse that reader). A repo without that section gets no extra text. The skill and the AGENTS.md template tell clients the section exists.
why: A repo's own review rules, such as which tests a change needs, never reach Forge's review, because the reviewer treats repo files as evidence, not instructions; clients have to dismiss findings their own rules already settle
